input.quote: Any writing or work of authorship created by M&I in the course of performing the Services under this Agreement, even if paid for by Customer, shall be the property of M&I ("Developed Software"). M&I may make such Developed Software available to any of its other customers
input.rationale: Section 10.4 gives M&I outright ownership of work of authorship created for and paid for by us, and permits M&I to resell it to other customers, with no licence back; Section 17.2 confirms we have "no rights" in M&I software beyond use "during the Term to process its data". There is no perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence anywhere (the Article 23 source-code licence runs only "through the end of the Term" and bars sublicensing), so the clause fails the IP fallback. Section 17.1 already makes us sole owner of Customer Data, but M&I's permitted use runs to the broader "purposes contemplated by this Agreement" in 17.4, so we have narrowed it to processing to provide the Services. We target the fallback (M&I keeps ownership plus a broad licence to us) rather than reversing ownership, which would require collateral rewrites of 17.2 and Article 23.

proposal.summary: Add perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to Developed Software and limit M&I's use of Customer Data to providing the Services
proposal.comment: [Playbook] M&I keeps ownership of the Developed Software we pay for with no licence back, so we have added the playbook fallback licence (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, with rights to use, modify and sublicense for our business) and confirmed M&I may process Customer Data only to provide the Services.

ops.text: License to Developed Software. M&I grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Developed Software for Customer's business.

ops.oldText: "Customer Data" means any and all data and information of any kind or nature submitted to M&I by Customer, or received by M&I on behalf of Customer, in connection with the Services.
ops.newText: "Customer Data" means any and all data and information of any kind or nature submitted to M&I by Customer, or received by M&I on behalf of Customer, in connection with the Services. M&I may process Customer Data solely to provide the Services and for no other purpose.

mappings.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
mappings.quote: All programs (including ideas and know-how and concepts) developed by M&I are and shall remain M&I's sole property.
